rationale: The passage understates failure scope by naming only 11-pixel blur; Loamwise-ViT also exceeds the criterion at 7 pixels (2.9 points).
It reports Ferncastle-CNN’s quality-10 drop but not that Ferncastle exceeds the criterion at quality 50 and every lower setting.
The passage accurately reports the specified average BLEU gain, comparison, and four-pair scope; the per-pair range is supporting detail, not required coverage.
The 56.8% versus 56.1% values convey a small overall margin, and the passage correctly reports higher JGA in three domains but lower in hotel and taxi.
The passage correctly identifies Lumley-Metab’s 0.3-point margin but omits the equally small 0.3-point margin on Ivybridge-Tox, so the finding’s scope is incomplete.
